scope: Separate fitted Windows quadratics from prepared scan leaves. Preserve fitted/implied points, layout, programs, source origins, native references and tolerances. Ink measurement and painting use one owned scan preparation path; no font-specific patch or new backend.

model.fitted: CreateWindowsFittedContours returns positioned quadratics before scan-grid rounding or subdivision, including half-F26 implied points.
model.scan: CreateWindowsScanContours uses the same bounded preparation for simple, composite and mapped glyphs. Both ink metrics and painting request this stage.
model.ownership: The existing segment accumulator owns scan storage. Its fitted temporary remains charged during preparation and releases after its last borrower, including refusal/cancellation. No cache or additional ownership abstraction.
model.rejectedShortcut: Rounding inside the fitted loader made images exact but broke the independently pinned half-F26 point contract. Keep that test and its reference values; expose the two actual stages instead.

mechanisms.scope: One original turning curve, four numerical phases, direct fitted/scan topology and independently captured alpha vectors. Each phase is an individual theory case.

contracts.scope: Refusal and cancellation after scan capacity is reserved, while the fitted temporary remains alive; baseline reservation restored, source unchanged, retry succeeds and final storage releases. No per-fixture API matrix.

rendering.scope: One canonical conversion per host, with original CC0 program/SVG and meaningful independent Windows/Linux references. Each platform has three agreeing fresh healthy/profile-cleaned captures.

retained.scope: Native fitted-point assertions and complete texture bytes are unchanged. Texture consumers select scan contours; point/profile/mapping consumers select fitted contours. The half-F26 regression stays intact.

fixtureInputNormalization.lineEnding: LF, matching the committed SVG blob
fixtureInputNormalization.qualification: Six fresh healthy/profile-cleaned captures of the canonical LF input match the existing PNG reference bytes. Original CRLF mechanism vectors and source digests remain explicit; neither geometry nor reference images changed.

qualification.timingScope: Functional wall times under ordinary development load. No benchmark or suite-simplification speedup claim.

suppliedContexts.scope: Same original source/program/materialized-native context and unchanged native observations. These exploratory replays alone do not admit whole-original font/resource/static-state acceptance.

windowsPhaseControls.recipe: Same size-18 O/P/Q at x=8,8.25,8.5,8.75 and y=30; 48x48 transparent image; normal-400 @font-face uses unchanged exact-outline transport.
windowsPhaseControls.scope: Prior independent phase observations retained; not additional routine fixtures or newly admitted references.

remaining: Matched Arial Windows contexts retain 13/6/5 pixel differences; Linux stays exact. Isolate their shared glyph stages separately.
All W1 sources still need complete resource/static/font context accounting; exact default or supplied-program output alone does not close an original.
